Agrolynx is a team that aims to bring together creativity, technology, and innovation to develop smart solutions for agribusiness challenges. Our purpose is to use technology to turn ideas into practical projects, promoting efficiency, sustainability, and modernization in the agricultural sector.

We believe that innovation is the way to build a more connected, productive, and sustainable future for the field.
summary:
Agrolynx is a digital platform developed to bring space technology closer to agriculture, helping farmers and agricultural professionals organize information and make more informed and sustainable decisions.

The project brings together agricultural management tools, geographic mapping of farms and fields, and information about soil, climate, crops, and irrigation. It also incorporates NASA data sources and scientific resources, including NASA POWER, NASA Earthdata CMR, and MODIS, making it possible to relate meteorological information and satellite observations of the Earth's surface to agricultural needs.

Agrolynx aims to contribute to more efficient and sustainable agriculture that is better prepared to face environmental and climate challenges. Its purpose is to transform scientific and geospatial data into useful information for people working in agriculture, bringing Earth observation closer to everyday farming decisions.
details:
Project Details — AGROLYNX

Agrolynx is a smart agriculture digital platform designed to connect space technology with the everyday needs of farmers. Its goal is to facilitate agricultural management and transform environmental, geographic, and meteorological information into useful knowledge to support decision-making in the field.

The platform brings together features for registering and managing rural properties, mapping agricultural fields, monitoring crops and growing seasons, organizing soil, climate, and irrigation information, as well as agricultural monitoring and planning.

One of the project's main differentiators is its use of scientific Earth observation resources. Agrolynx works with NASA data sources, including NASA POWER, NASA Earthdata CMR, and MODIS observation data, to relate climate information and satellite observations to agricultural needs. These resources expand the possibilities for monitoring environmental conditions and vegetation.

The intended impact is to contribute to more efficient and sustainable agriculture by helping farmers and agricultural professionals better understand the conditions of their properties, plan activities, and use natural resources more responsibly. The project also aims to bring space technologies closer to small and medium-sized farmers, making scientific information more accessible.

The project was developed using React, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS for the user interface, along with Node.js and Express for the server infrastructure. It also uses georeferencing concepts and geographic data to represent agricultural areas.

Its creative aspect lies in integrating farm management and satellite observation into a single modular platform. Rather than keeping information about climate, soil, vegetation, and properties separate, Agrolynx proposes bringing these elements together in an organized environment designed for future expansion.

The team prioritized accessibility, information organization, ease of use, visual identity, and the ability to incorporate new scientific data sources. Some integrations and advanced features are still under development, allowing the platform to evolve progressively.

Agrolynx represents an initiative to bring together space science, technology, and agriculture, demonstrating how Earth observation data can help address real-world challenges in agricultural production.
